$comment: SKETCH of this app on platform v2 (plan app-platform section 12). Not loaded by today's runtime; cmux-app.json is the live manifest. The data stays with its owners: connections and team policy in ConnectionDO, credentials and tool catalogs in the integration gateway. The app is UI and onboarding.

scopes.integration:read: List your team's connections, their health, tools and the team's integration policy.

optionalScopes.integration:write: Connect, sign in again, share, disconnect, or change a tool's policy when you click those buttons.
optionalScopes.feed:read: Show tool approval requests and sign-in problems in your feed.

cmux.credential.provider/1.$comment: Lets another app (an HTTP or database client) ask for a credential for a host. The app shows a picker of matching connections; the shell returns a cred_ handle the gateway resolves. Secrets never enter either app.

cmux.feed.source/1.$comment: The gateway posts the items; this app renders their bodies and actions. integration.approval: an Ask tool waits for approval (Approve once / Always allow / Block). integration.reauth: a connection needs sign-in.

ops.name: integrations.connect
ops.$comment: Completes only with a human at the provider; not on MCP or automations.

palette.title: Add an API from a Spec

v2Gaps: Pane kinds are not in V2's place interfaces: the main pane needs a `cmux.pane/1` (or a native pane for first-party apps).
No secure input in the scene vocabulary: credential collection must stay a shell sheet (proposed integration.connect host behavior), never a TextField in an app.
No URL-open host capability for OAuth approval pages from an app with a gesture.
No Table or Segmented control in V7's component list: the Allow / Ask / Block control is three tappable Texts.
cmux.feed.source/1 has no schema yet for action buttons that answer with a policy change (Always allow).
